_comment: Pinned, not because the generated default was wrong — it already reads
[minecraft, immersiveengineering, mekanism] — but because it is generated,
from whichever mods happened to be installed the first time the server
started. Adding a mod later could reorder it and quietly move the canonical
steel on a fresh world. Written down, it is a decision instead of an
Immersive Engineering wins the shared materials. Measured on a live server:
c:ingots/steel has four providers (Ad Astra, IE, Mekanism, Railcraft) and
c:plates/steel three, and with this order Ad Astra's own alloying recipe
outputs immersiveengineering:ingot_steel while its compressor outputs
immersiveengineering:plate_steel. Railcraft's lead and nickel ores smelt to
the IE ingots the same way. 609 recipes rewritten, 86 duplicates dropped,
Only the keys we change are listed — AlmostUnified fills the rest in from
its own defaults and rewrites the file, measured: four keys in, eleven out,
with the tag patterns and stone variants restored untouched.
